title: Required browser handoffs and continuation/recovery prompts
intent: Preserve required saved ZIP delivery after each bounded browser scope while keeping GitHub as current source authority and making interruptions recoverable.

requirements.description: Provide separate complete browser continuation and interrupted-thread recovery prompts.
requirements.acceptance: Both prompts retain one bounded scope and required saved ZIP delivery.

requirements.description: Reconcile current GitHub authority with supplied handoffs and actual capabilities.
requirements.acceptance: Prompts require explicit pinned reads, actual refs/ownership, current plan and available tools.

requirements.description: Preserve progress before an unpredictable thread interruption.
requirements.acceptance: Early durable checkpoints and meaningful-phase updates include actual partial work and unknown operations.

requirements.description: Complete integration and branch lifecycle accurately.
requirements.acceptance: Finished reviewed scope merges with verified main; unfinished branches persist; deletion is verified or explicitly pending.

requirements.description: Make confirmed saved handoff delivery a completion gate.
requirements.acceptance: Current instructions require verified session ZIP and actual Library identity before task completion.

requirements.description: Preserve historical archive semantics and material.
requirements.acceptance: C262 bytes/hash remain unchanged; new session ZIP declares online scope and external historical dependency.

requirements.description: Provide downloadable reusable prompts and one usable new session ZIP.
requirements.acceptance: Saved files include prompts, checkpoint, next action, recovery state, frozen workflow snapshots, manifest and evidence.

requirements.description: Verify and stop without scientific scope expansion.
requirements.acceptance: Documentation and workflow checks plus independent review pass; no product files, fixtures, budgets or hosted workflows change.

verification: Read current GitHub workflow and C262 root controls; resolve the existing Library folder

verification: Independent review of ordinary continuation, crash recovery and delivery-only recovery
